video_title: Hear from from Donovan Mitchell, James Harden, Jalen Brunson & more after Knicks' Game 3 win | SC

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on team focus and O.G. Anunoby's great play
quotes.excerpt: O.G.'s playing great. Most importantly, he's locked in and he's doing the things that we know that he's capable of.
quotes.quote: You don't look ahead. Most importantly, you just deal with what's in front of you. So we have the first possession, we have the first quarter, and then you have the end the first half, and then you go on and you go on. We just continue to just deal with what's in front of you and just have your teammates back, make sure everyone's on the same page, making sure everyone's holding each other accountable. That's just the most important thing right now. O.G.'s playing great. Most importantly, he's locked in and he's doing the things that we know that he's capable of and he's been playing great, he's looking great. He's just doing what he does.

quotes.speaker: Mikal Bridges
quotes.summary_phrase: Mikal Bridges and Jalen Brunson on Coach Mike Brown's impact
quotes.excerpt: Just keeping us locked in. I mean, I don't think anything, we have to do any comparison or anything, but just him just staying locked in and coaching us to the clock hits zero, you know, no matter what the score is. We need that.

text_blocks.speaker: Mikal Bridges
text_blocks.text: Just keeping us locked in. I mean, I don't think anything, we have to do any comparison or anything, but just him just staying locked in and coaching us to the clock hits zero, you know, no matter what the score is. We need that.

text_blocks.speaker: Jalen Brunson
text_blocks.text: Just keep your mind on the task at hand. Games over. We found a way to win tonight, but we got to have the same desperation like it's 0-0, it's Game 1. We got to go out there, we got to execute at a high level and we got to be disciplined in our game plan.

quotes.speaker: Donovan Mitchell
quotes.summary_phrase: Donovan Mitchell on Knicks fans chanting in Cleveland
quotes.excerpt: I'm from New York, this isn't shock me. They do it in every arena. It's like Cowboys fans.
quotes.quote: I mean, I'm from New York, this isn't shock me. They do it in every arena. It's like Cowboys fans. That's just who they are. I don't think it's a Cleveland thing. It wasn't just us, you look at Philly, look at, that's who Knicks fans are. It was one back in the day, so like, you know what I mean? So that had nothing to do with what we got going. Cleveland's the best fans in the world. I stand on that. So that doesn't affect that, that doesn't label who Cleveland is. I have nothing but love for the fans in Cleveland. And we didn't get it done for our home crowd tonight. And we didn't get it done, which enables the Knicks fans to go off like they did. If we get it done, then they're silent, right? So we didn't do our part. When we ran out, they were loud and Cleveland fans were behind us, but we didn't do our part and that's the result.

quotes.speaker: Donovan Mitchell
quotes.summary_phrase: Donovan Mitchell takes accountability for team's fatigue
quotes.excerpt: We did it to ourselves. So we can't be mad now. One game at a time. Let's get Monday and go from there.
quotes.quote: We did it to ourselves. So we can't be mad now. One game at a time. Let's get Monday and go from there.

quotes.speaker: James Harden
quotes.summary_phrase: James Harden on missed shots impacting defense and team confidence
quotes.excerpt: We just not making them and that's a part of, you know, the game. When you make shots, it's a little bit easier.
quotes.quote: We just not making them and that's a part of, you know, the game. When you make shots, it's a little bit easier. You make, you miss them, it's a little bit more difficult. We, you know, at times, we miss shots, but we found ways to still win games. That's a part of it, but yeah, we got another opportunity on Monday. One game at a time. That's all you can control. You got to make some shots. I don't know how many shots we made or missed, but I feel like we haven't really made a shot since the first couple quarters in Game 1. Got to make shots. Not just this team, any team. We're still confident. Confidence is never going away. We're more than capable. We just need some things to shift, change and make some shots, the series turns around.

quotes.speaker: Kenny Atkinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenny Atkinson on Cavaliers' shooting struggles and Knicks' physicality
quotes.excerpt: I think we won the expected all three games. So it's just, you know, but there's expected and real.

text_blocks.speaker: Joe Vardon
text_blocks.text: Yeah, Fred was telling me before the game like your expected shooting percentage is like, going into tonight was like eight points lower than what it should be. So, I mean, that speaks to what you've been saying.

text_blocks.speaker: Kenny Atkinson
text_blocks.text: I think we won the expected all three games. So it's just, you know, but there's expected and real. This is where we always get into that conversation, Joe. So, you know, but they, listen, they, they took, you know, they, they were, they were the more physical team tonight. I think their physicality and energy. We, we just couldn't, we couldn't get to that level to, to combat it. I think the turnovers hurt us, Joe, and I think, you know, Shamet getting loose there, you know, they had a role player step up on the road, you know, but, um, you know, there was no, whatever the stats say tonight, they were, they were the much better team.
